title: First Days in the Nest
development: Baby rests in the gentle curled womb posture, comforted by your heartbeat, scent, and voice.
tip: Skin-to-skin touch calms baby's breathing, stabilizes temperature, and comforts you both.

title: First Week of Life
development: Strong primary reflexes. Baby focuses clearly at 8 to 12 inches — the exact distance to your face when nursing.
tip: Follow baby's hunger cues on demand. Embrace quiet resting windows.

title: One Month Milestone
development: First voluntary social smiles begin! Neck muscles show slight steadying when upright on your shoulder.
tip: Celebrate one whole month together. You've navigated the tenderest, most intense days with grace.

title: Two Months
development: Delightful warm smiles and tracking moving toys with head turns.
tip: Vaccination week: extra nursing, cuddles, and soothing skin contact.

title: Three Months
development: Hand-eye coordination blossoms: reaches for soft toys and coos happily.
tip: Offer lightweight teethers and gentle tactile sensory rattles.

title: One Year Celebration!
development: Cruising furniture or taking brave first steps. Babbles recognizable syllables and points.
tip: Congratulations, mama! A full 365 days of dedication, nocturnal triumphs, and endless love.
